entries.15bb0155ca1042bf: This business plans, develops, produces and sells content for home game consoles, arcade game machines and mobile devices, and also engages in the planning, production and sales of masters for music and video content, the development of images for pachinko and pachislot machines, and the planning, production and operation of concerts and events. The company and four consolidated subsidiaries (Fain Co., Ltd., Yūkusu Myūjikku Co., Ltd., Aquaplus Co., Ltd. and Fikkusu Rekōdo Co., Ltd.) carry out this business; as a single segment, revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥4,288 million. Its head office is located in Sakai, Osaka Prefecture.
